documents.title: COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Modis Navnirman Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax compared to the previous year. Management discussed steady operational execution across ongoing residential projects in Mumbai, ongoing expansion into new micro-markets like Santacruz and Khar through an asset-light redevelopment model, and stable demand in the real estate sector despite supply increases. The company also addressed challenges related to material and labor costs caused by war situations during the quarter. Modis Navnirman Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing by 27.9% year-on-year to ₹58.26 crore and PAT rising by 25.8% to ₹8.54 crore. Construction progressed steadily across key ongoing projects such as Rashmi Square, Rashmi Signature, Rashmi Delight, Rashmi Manorath, Rashmi Icon, and Rashmi Avenue.
